title: Trump’s Latest Tariffs Revive Focus on Pressuring China
summary: President Trump sent a message to trading partners across Asia, many of which depend on trade and investment from both the United States and China, that he is ready to escalate tariffs.
body_markdown: President Trump sent a message to trading partners across Asia, many of which depend on trade and investment from both the United States and China, that he is ready to escalate tariffs.
